W.note: Dense five-column grid with a complete cart drawer (steppers, remove, free-shipping nudge, tax, checkout), stock tags and sold-out and max-in-cart states, though the mobile two-column grid clips at the right edge.

X.note: Restrained line-art products and clear variant chips, but the cart is only a counter with no review or checkout, a dev-only 'Simulate a failed add' toggle sits in the header, and the mobile header overflows while mixing EUR and USD.

Y.note: Very restrained styling and a readable text cart list, but three products leave most of the desktop page empty, the cart has no quantity controls or checkout, the default-selected variant is sold out, and mobile clips the second card.

Z.note: Tight five-column cards with category, rating, price and a labeled Add to cart row, plus a working drawer with steppers and disabled checkout when empty, but it lacks stock or sold-out states and mobile overflows with the chip row and grid cut off.
